faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHFWS Cooch Behar Phlebotomist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Phlebotomist post is 23 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Phlebotomist in DHFWS Cooch Behar?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Phlebotomist post under the DHFWS Cooch Behar Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for DHFWS Cooch Behar Phlebotomist posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Phlebotomist posts is online. Interested and eligible candidates must apply through the official website within the specified dates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Phlebotomist in DHFWS Cooch Behar?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Phlebotomist position will receive a salary of Rs. 5500 per month. This is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to DHFWS Cooch Behar Phlebotomist Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Phlebotomist post should not be more than 50 years of age. Please refer to the official notification for any age relaxation details.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Phlebotomist post?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed Madhyamik or equivalent and completed a Phlebotomy Technician training course from a recognized organization, or have at least one year of experience as a Phlebotomist.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DHFWS Cooch Behar Phlebotomist Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DHFWS Cooch Behar Phlebotomist Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Phlebotomist in DHFWS Cooch Behar?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Phlebotomist post primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their eligibility and documents submitted.

faq.question: Q9. When does the online application start for DHFWS Cooch Behar Phlebotomist Recruitment?
faq.answer: The online application process for the Phlebotomist recruitment by DHFWS Cooch Behar starts on 17 September 2026. Candidates can apply from this date onwards.
